verdict.rationale: The pack shows downloadable native-precision weights and names one distilled model, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B. That model appears to be a DeepSeek-produced distill, not a community replica. Nothing documents community fine-tunes, quantizations or replicas on public hubs, or any attribution of what is official versus community. Weight availability and third-party API hosting such as OpenRouter are adjacent to the story, not evidence of a derivative ecosystem.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a real derivative ecosystem exists around the model — community replicas, fine-tunes, or quantizations on public hubs — with clear attribution of what is and is not official
